sequences.name: RESET_STABILITY
sequences.objective: Verify that reset deassertion leads to ready within the allowed window.
sequences.expected_result: ready == 1 within 20 cycles after reset release
sequences.human_review: Confirm reset deassertion timing with the design owner.

sequences.name: BURST_WRITE_ACK
sequences.objective: Verify that four consecutive writes receive acknowledgements.
sequences.human_review: Confirm whether address wraparound is legal.

sequences.name: CLOCK_JITTER_TOLERANCE
sequences.objective: Verify that the block remains stable when clock jitter is applied within environment limits.
sequences.expected_result: ready remains stable during jitter run
sequences.human_review: Confirm jitter distribution and measurement method.
